protocolNotes.1: Protocol 1.x: the workspace sat inside the repository in 1.0 (candidates could reach other runs and were handed the benchmark's own scoring notes); 1.1 moved it out. No enforced isolation; candidates sourced samples from the internet.
protocolNotes.2: Protocol 2.0: workspace outside the repository, but no enforced isolation — a candidate could read whatever its harness's own sandbox allowed, including this machine's disk and the internet. Candidates sourced their own samples.
protocolNotes.3: Protocol 3.0: candidates run in a lockdown with none of the operator's filesystem and no internet (only their own model API), are not told which model or run they are, and work under a fixed budget with at most two seal-failure rounds per phase; packages come from a fixed offline mirror and recorded samples from one shared raw pack; tokens and cost come from the gateway's log; grading is blind and boxed, and sound is measured by the harness. Phases graded before grader blinding 2 (2026-11-18) gave the grader a copy of the seal record that still named the producing model and its token usage, so their grading was not fully blind; their scores stand as graded.
